jobs.prompt:
Original character-design illustration in the project's KINETIC_CEL anime style: refined adult faces, pressure-varying navy-black ink lines, economical interior linework, large flat colors and at most two clean hard-edged cel shadows, warm white empty background, subtle flat ground shadow. Match the human illustration style of references; preserve identified existing face designs where specified. No photorealism, no 3D, no PBR, no soft airbrushing, no gradient, no dense fabric rendering, no glowing eyes. Full bodies head-to-toe with complete boots and generous margins, distinct expressions/postures/body shapes. ABSOLUTELY no letters, numbers, readable writing, printed insignia, logos, captions, borders or watermarks. Empty papers contain faint blank structural lines only, no pseudo-writing.
Create a WIDE landscape 2:1 group character design board of EXACTLY FIVE HUMAN BROTHERS from a spacefaring repair-worker family. Five young men, visibly related through brows/eyes but NOT clones and NOT five identical handsome model bodies. All are active mechanic-pilots in shared practical ivory/navy pressure-workwear with durable belts, gloves, kneepads and boots, personalized by different accent colors. No robot bodies. No numbered text. They are siblings who searched for their missing father and now have to ask what he did while repairing an occupying warship. Honest understated human emotion, not triumphant superhero poses. Age appearances are proposal only: young adult eldest through a late-teen youngest, avoid little children. Five separated full-body standing figures in a natural shallow arc. LEFT TO RIGHT fixed identity arrangement:
FIRST, eldest brother Shinyi: use the FIRST reference man's exact recognizable face and black side-swept hair, lean athletic body and white/navy pilot-workwear with restrained red shoulder line. Stern calm eyes, mouth held tightly, a folded blank maintenance map in one hand; the other hand rests low around a CLOSED old wooden-handle folding workknife, no exposed blade. Responsible and exhausted, head angled toward next brother, not glamour pose. Keep original face rather than inventing a new man.
SECOND, Yu: a NEW face, slightly taller and noticeably lankier than eldest, tousled black hair curling up behind BOTH ears, family eye/brow resemblance without identical jaw. Longer soft face, emotional worried eyes. Ivory/navy work coverall partly unzipped over navy undershirt, cyan-blue small cuff detail, dusty sleeves. Clutches a crumpled wiping cloth, other hand half raised toward his elder brother's sleeve, as though asking him to keep reporting back. Not a duplicate of first, no long braid, no female outfit.
THIRD, Ayue: use SECOND reference man's strong jaw, close dark curls, warm brown complexion and robust build, but a young-adult repair-pilot presence. Olive/ivory workwear and broad load-bearing harness, neck pressure seal, yellow small safety tabs. Shorter than Yu, much broader through chest and forearms. Holds a heavy mechanical LOCKING HANDLE down at his side, tool not weapon. Serious stubborn expression, one small healing lip mark only, no blood. Preserve recognizable reference face and body type.
FOURTH, unnamed brother: NEW family face, very straight close-cropped black hair, rectangular glasses, angular narrow cheekbones, average height and slender wiry hands. Dark navy work suit with muted teal shoulder facing, small field-measurement reel and rolled blank wiring sketch at belt. Slightly bent forward checking a simple unlit handheld meter; practical cerebral posture, not looking at audience. No invented name.
FIFTH, youngest unnamed brother: NEW rounder youthful face, short uneven dark fringe, shorter stature with compact build, ivory/navy loose work suit with ochre cuffs, simple knee pads. Holds a small clean metal parts tin in both hands against abdomen; almost-smile mixed with worry while looking toward his brothers. No mascot proportions, no little child body, no name invented.
All FIVE are clearly male human siblings. Do not import the older project's female pilots into these five brothers. Keep a lived-in working-class family identity with minimal grime, not a military fashion lineup. No helmets hiding faces; no repeated helmet-under-arm pose; visible hands and complete boots.

Original character-design illustration in the project's KINETIC_CEL anime style: refined adult faces, pressure-varying navy-black ink lines, economical interior linework, large flat colors and at most two clean hard-edged cel shadows, warm white empty background, subtle flat ground shadow. Match the human illustration style of references; preserve identified existing face designs where specified. No photorealism, no 3D, no PBR, no soft airbrushing, no gradient, no dense fabric rendering, no glowing eyes. Full bodies head-to-toe with complete boots and generous margins, distinct expressions/postures/body shapes. ABSOLUTELY no letters, numbers, readable writing, printed insignia, logos, captions, borders or watermarks. Empty papers contain faint blank structural lines only, no pseudo-writing.
Create ONE landscape 3:2 character-design board focused on TWO different HUMAN pilots of the Five Beasts team, returning travelers with their belongings. Use the two reference men as exact accepted visual face/clothing sources; this is a proposed new story-name binding, not new invented replacement faces. Two large complete full-body figures side by side, neither cropped, with clean space between them. No giant mecha in this board. They are NOT siblings and NOT the electromagnetic team. Practical restrained sci-fi travelers, a little older and more road-worn than the young five brothers.
LEFT, Lorn: preserve FIRST reference face, angular features, straight dark hair tied into its long loose braid/ponytail, ivory short work jacket with RED turned-up inner collar, navy undershirt, ivory wide work trousers and navy boots. Same recognizably handsome face but contemplative, tense, slightly tired eyes; no self-satisfied heroic grin. Both gloves clipped to belt so bare human hands can be seen. One hand turns a small OLD metal house key on a plain ring, the other carries TWO blank folded official papers with no readable writing or emblems. A subtle healed forehead scratch can suggest his recent ordeal. Relaxed grounded posture with shoulders burdened by travel; his old house is occupied by another family and he refuses to force them out, but cannot yet let the key go. Do not add a sword, crown, royal mantle or gun.
RIGHT, Tim: preserve SECOND reference man's wavy brown hair, light stubble, broader slightly rugged face, GREEN/navy work-travel suit with ivory chest insert, harness and practical boots. Calm observant practical expression, looking toward Lorn without lecturing. Substantial worn rectangular travel backpack with bedroll and visible cinch straps; one hand draws a strap snug. A SMALL terracotta flowerpot with one newly cut leafy sprig is carefully tied on a padded side sling of backpack, stem protected from a hard box edge. In his other hand he carries one modest metal hot-drink cup; believable fingers. His role reads as the person who brings a drink and packs the fragile plant safely. No helmet-under-arm fashion pose.
Preserve color-block identities and exact reference face/hair distinction. The ivory-clad man should not receive green man's curls or beard, green man should not receive long braid. Keep no text or A/B/C from references. A few simple straps and seams, not excessive buckles. Complete feet, warm white paper background, unified KINETIC_CEL hard shadows. No additional named people.
